summary: T16a EXPERIMENTAL RESULTS CANNOT BE INTERPRETED CHEMICALLY

claims.claim: GRASP-A3 aromaticity and hybridization are confirmed as INPUT fields (not learned)
claims.evidence:
"is_input":{"aromatic":true,"hybridization":true}

FALSIFIABLE TEST: RDKit SMARTS pattern for sp2 carbon in benzene ring should show 100% agreement with bundle.aromatic field
claims.prediction: If aromatic/hybridization are truly inputs: 1.0 agreement between bundle fields and RDKit computation

claims.claim: NO LAYER DATA WAS COLLECTED FOR ANY CONCEPT IN EITHER A3 OR A2
claims.evidence:
"layers":{} for ALL concepts in BOTH model pairs; "Best Error=None, Learned Gain=None" printed output

FALSIFIABLE TEST: Check results.json structure - every concept should have layers dict with keys '0','1','2'...'12'
claims.prediction: If experiment succeeded: each concept has model/control scores at all layers

claims.claim: BUNDLE BASELINE VALUES EXIST BUT CANNOT BE INTERPRETED WITHOUT PROBE SCORES
claims.evidence:
"ring_size":{"a2":{"bundle_baseline":0.132}} etc.

FALSIFIABLE TEST: Compare bundle baseline to model error at best layer - learned_gain = control_error/model_error requires both values
claims.prediction: If experiment succeeded: all concepts have valid best_err and learned_gain > 1.0

claims.claim: A3 RANDOM CONTROL CANNOT BE COMPARED TO A2 OR ANYTHING ELSE
claims.evidence:
"a3_random" pair has no layer data; "figure_error":"'a3'" indicates figure generation failed

FALSIFIABLE TEST: Check if a3_random probe results exist in any concept dict under 'control'
claims.test: results[concept]['a3']['layers'][L]['control'] must be numeric for at least one layer L
claims.prediction: If experiment succeeded: control scores match model score format (float, not None)

claims.claim: LEARNED GAIN CANNOT BE CALCULATED - NO LEARNING CAN BE INFERRED ABOUT GRASP-A3 REPRESENTATION
claims.evidence:
"learned_gain":None for ALL concepts; learned_gain = control_error/model_error requires both errors to be non-None

FALSIFIABLE TEST: At best layer, model error must differ from random control error by >0.1x factor
claims.test: results[concept]['a3']['learned_gain'] must exist and be numeric (not None)
claims.prediction: If A3 learns chemistry beyond inputs: learned_gain >> 1.0 at best layer

trivial_explanations: The experiment failed due to script errors - this is NOT a chemical finding about GRASP-A3
Bundle baseline values are computed from input fields alone (aromatic, hybridization already given) so they cannot indicate learning
No learned_gain can be calculated when both model and control have no layer data
